prompt: Redraw as a troll hide tanner's lodge: a long low lodge with walls of stretched hides on big timber frames lashed with leather, hides pegged out flat on wooden racks built onto the side walls as part of the structure, a smoke-blackened timber smoke chimney, a dry-stone foundation, a wide open doorway framed by two big horns. Hand-painted stylized fantasy game building, Breath of the Wild meets Overwatch, a tiny bit cartoonish, rich clean colours, warm grey stone, rich brown wood, cream bone. CLEAN, no dirt, no grime, no blood, no gore.
